title: Cross-Critique Annex v1
description: Schema for cross-critique.json — the advisory annex produced by the in-gate cross-critique phase (ADR-0026) and by the pre-PR adversarial-review lane (ADR-0027). The annex never rewrites persisted reviewer verdicts; it annotates them.

schema_version.description: Schema identifier. Bump on breaking changes.

round_id.description: Identifies the round this annex annotates (e.g. 'spec/attempt-1/round-1' or the branch slug for a pre-PR lane run).

status.description: 'complete' — the phase ran and all verdicts are present. 'unavailable' — the phase could not run (context lost, API failure, etc.); the loop continues without blocking.

unavailable_reason.description: Required when status == 'unavailable'. Describes why the phase did not complete.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of annex creation.

verdicts.description: Per-finding cross-critique verdicts from both reviewers.

target_finding_id.description: The checks[].id from the persisted reviewer output being critiqued (e.g. 'A-3', 'B-C1').

verdict.description: Normative verdict vocabulary (ADR-0026 §5). PROPOSE-REJECT and PROPOSE-SEVERITY-CHANGE require basis.kind == code_evidence or spec_evidence.

proposed_severity.description: Required when verdict == PROPOSE-SEVERITY-CHANGE. Must use the loop's severity vocabulary (Critical|Major|Minor), not CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW.

fix_critique.description: Optional. When the finding stands but the proposed fix is wrong, disproportionate, or over-engineered, state the minimal alternative here.

then.description: PROPOSE-REJECT and PROPOSE-SEVERITY-CHANGE require basis.kind == code_evidence|spec_evidence AND citations must be present. Note: AJV 6+ correctly enforces nested if/then; validate with strict mode enabled.

kind.description: PROPOSE-REJECT and PROPOSE-SEVERITY-CHANGE require code_evidence or spec_evidence. A concern alone is insufficient to propose rejection or a severity change.

citations.description: At least one citation is required for PROPOSE-REJECT and PROPOSE-SEVERITY-CHANGE.

basis.description: Evidence or concern backing the verdict. Distinguishes decided evidence from unverified concerns (arXiv:2608.18167 §concern classification).

kind.description: code_evidence: a file:line citation that directly refutes or confirms the finding. spec_evidence: a requirement/AC/ADR that directly bears on the finding. concern: a plausible objection that could not be verified this session. A concern does not auto-reject or auto-adopt — the finding author must respond with evidence, a withdrawal, or an escalation to human judgement.

citations.description: Required for code_evidence and spec_evidence. Each citation pins the exact location.

claim.description: The concrete assertion the citation supports (e.g. 'validate-review-context-set.sh:262-265 prevents resumption, so the cost argument is wrong').

scope.description: Scope judgement for this finding relative to the approved task boundary (arXiv:2608.18167 scope-creep mitigation, issue #348).

assessment.description: in_scope: the finding addresses a behaviour or risk within the approved requirements/acceptance-tests/tasks. out_of_scope: the finding concerns a behaviour outside the approved boundary; implementing it without human approval is scope creep. unclear: the boundary is ambiguous; a human must decide before any fix is requested.

related_requirements.description: REQ-* IDs from requirements.md that this finding relates to. Required for in_scope assessments.

related_acceptance_tests.description: AC-* IDs from requirements.md that this finding relates to.

related_tasks.description: T-* IDs from tasks.md that this finding relates to.

evidence.description: File:line or ID reference supporting the scope assessment.

then.description: in_scope requires at least one of related_requirements, related_acceptance_tests, or related_tasks.
